title: Calderon-type commutators and chamber lifting in the Dunkl setting
summary: Let $G$ be a finite reflection group, and let $T_j$, $Δ_κ$, and $dω$ denote its Dunkl operators, Laplacian, and measure, respectively. Write $\mathcal R_j=-T_j(-Δ_κ)^{-1/2}$ for the $j$th Dunkl Riesz transform. We study the Calderón-type commutator $[M_b,T_i\mathcal R_j]$ on the full space $L^p(\R^N,dω)$, without assuming $G$-invariance of the functions.
